resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Custom Names[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

Custom names can be used for tables as well. You can shorten the join statements by giving the tables "nicknames":[code format="sql" ]SELECT ct.ID, ct.Name, ord.Name, ord.Amount
FROM customers [b]AS ct[/b], orders[b] AS ord[/b]
WHERE ct.ID=ord.Customer_ID
ORDER BY ct.ID;[/code]
[note]As you can see, we shortened the table names as we used them in our query.[/note]

resolved.title: 联合查询Join 的类型
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Types of Join[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

The following are the types of JOIN that can be used in MySQL:
[b]- INNER[/b] JOIN
[b]- LEFT[/b] JOIN
[b]- RIGHT[/b] JOIN

INNER JOIN is equivalent to JOIN. It returns rows when there is a match between the tables.
[s0l0!-header][b]Syntax:[/b][/s0l0!-header] [code format="sql" ]SELECT column_name(s)
FROM table1[b] INNER JOIN[/b] table2 
[b]ON [/b]table1.column_name=table2.column_name;[/code]
[note]Note the [b]ON [/b]keyword for specifying the inner join condition.[/note]
The image below demonstrates how INNER JOIN works: [img id="2833" width="100%"]
[note]Only the records matching the join condition are returned.[/note]

resolved.title: 商品分类目录
resolved.problem_statement_md:
假设你在一家超市工作，你需要按类别排列商品。你得到了以下表格。

商品表**products**:

![](/content/assets/f68b00721b58089a4ba0.jpeg)

类别表**categories**:

![](/content/assets/03bc8ae22545d47803a2.jpeg)

每个商品品都有一个类别，在商品中列`categoryid` 关联了 类别表。

请写一个查询，在一个表中输出所有商品及其类别.

最终查询结果包含的列字段为:（`productname`,`price`,`categoryname`）。
resolved.problem_statement_en_md:
[s0l0!-header][h1]INNER JOIN[/h1][/s0l0!-header]

You are working at a supermarket and you need to arrange products by categories. You are given the following tables:

[b]products:[/b][img id="4489" width="100%"]
[b]categories:[/b][img id="4490" width="100%"]
Each product has a category.
Write a query to output all products with their categories (productname-price-categoryname) in one table.
[note]Don't forget about the [b]ON[/b] keyword while using [b]INNER JOIN[/b].[/note]
resolved.hint_md: 在使用**INNER JOIN**时不要忘记**ON**关键字。

code_templates.solution_code:
SELECT products.productname, products.price, categories.categoryname
FROM products INNER JOIN categories
ON products.categoryid = categories.id

resolved.title: 左连接 LEFT JOIN
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]LEFT JOIN[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

The [b]LEFT JOIN[/b] returns all rows from the left table, even if there are no matches in the right table. 

This means that if there are no matches for the [b]ON [/b]clause in the table on the right, the join will still return the rows from the first table in the result.

[s0l0!-header][b]The basic syntax of LEFT JOIN is as follows:[/b][/s0l0!-header] [code format="sql" ]SELECT table1.column1, table2.column2...
FROM table1 [b]LEFT OUTER JOIN[/b] table2
[b]ON [/b]table1.column_name = table2.column_name;[/code]
[note]The [b]OUTER [/b]keyword is optional, and can be omitted.[/note]
The image below demonstrates how LEFT JOIN works: [img id="2834" width="100%"]
Consider the following tables.
[s0l0!-header][b]customers:[/b][/s0l0!-header] [img id="2835" width="100%"]
[s0l0!-header][b]items:[/b][/s0l0!-header][img id="2993" width="100%"]  
The following SQL statement will return all [b]customers[/b], and the [b]items [/b]they might have: [code format="sql" codeId="3064"]SELECT customers.Name, items.Name 
FROM customers [b]LEFT OUTER JOIN[/b] items 
[b]ON [/b]customers.ID=items.Seller_id;[/code]
[s0l0!-header][b]Result:[/b][/s0l0!-header][img id="2994" width="100%"]  
The result set contains all the rows from the left table and matching data from the right table. 
[note]If no match is found for a particular row, [b]NULL [/b]is returned.[/note]

resolved.title: 右连接 RIGHT JOIN
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]RIGHT JOIN[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

The [b]RIGHT JOIN[/b] returns all rows from the right table, even if there are no matches in the left table. [img id="2838" width="100%"]
The basic syntax of RIGHT JOIN is as follows: [code format="sql" ]SELECT table1.column1, table2.column2...
FROM table1 [b]RIGHT OUTER JOIN[/b] table2
ON table1.column_name = table2.column_name;[/code]
[note]Again, the [b]OUTER [/b]keyword is optional, and can be omitted.[/note]
Consider the same example from our previous lesson, but this time with a RIGHT JOIN: [code format="sql" codeId="3065"]SELECT customers.Name, items.Name FROM customers
RIGHT JOIN items ON customers.ID=items.Seller_id;[/code]
[s0l0!-header][b]Result:[/b][/s0l0!-header] [img id="2995" width="100%"]  
The RIGHT JOIN returns all the rows from the right table (items), even if there are no matches in the left table (customers).
[note]There are other types of joins in the SQL language, but they are not supported by MySQL.[/note]
